title: चीन जान लागेका रास्वपा सांसदलाई प्रधानमन्त्रीको निर्देशन- भ्रमण घुमघाममा मात्रै केन्द्रित नहोस्
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन शाहले चीन भ्रमणमा जान लागेका रास्वपाका सांसदहरूसँग भेटवार्ता गरेका छन्। आज सिंहदरबारमा बोलाएर रास्वपा संसदीय दलका नेता समेत रहेका शाहले छलफल गरेका हुन्। चिनियाँ कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (सीपीसी) को औपचारिक निमन्त्रणामा रास्वपाका महामन्त्री विपिन आचार्यको नेतृत्वमा पार्टीको उच्चस्तरीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डल कार्तिक २९ गतेदेखि चीनको भ्रमण जाँदैछ। भ्रमणअघि प्रधानमन्त्रीले आफूहरूलाई बोलाएर आवश्यक निर्देशन दिएको प्रमुख सचेतक कवीन्द्र बुर्लाकोटीले बताए। उनले भने, ‘हामीले भ्रमणको बारेमा केही कुराहरू राख्यौँ, दुई देशबीचको सम्बन्ध र हामी जाँदा अपनाउनुपर्ने सावधानीका कुरामा प्रधानमन्त्रीबाट केही निर्देशन भयो।’ प्रधानमन्त्रीले पार्टीका सांसदहरूको भ्रमण फलदायी हुने विश्वास भेटमा व्यक्त गरेको उनले बताए। उनले भने, ‘दुई देशको सम्बन्धलाई प्रगाढ बनाउनेमा भ्रमणलाई सफल बनाउनुहोला भन्ने हिसाबको निर्देशन भयो। हाम्रो देशले चीनबाट लिनसक्ने विभिन्न लाभ धेरै हुनसक्छन्, जस्तै टेक्नोलोजी, व्यापारिक, आर्थिक लाभसहित अरू आयामहरू हुनसक्छन्, पर्यटनका कुराहरू हुनसक्छन्। सँगसँगै कृषिको आधुनिकीकरणका कुराहरू चीनबाट धेरै कुराहरू हामीले लिएर आउन सक्छौँ। यो चिजमा अलि बढी ध्यान दिएर गर्नुहोला भन्नुभयो।’ उनले भ्रमण घुमघामको लागि मात्रै सीमित नगर्न निर्देशन भएको पनि बताए। बुर्लाकोटीले थपे, ‘भ्रमणमा घुमघाम मात्रै नहोस्, दुई देशको हितको लागि र विशेषगरी नेपालको हितको लागि काम गर्नसक्ने हिसाबको भ्रमण होस् भन्ने हिसाबको निर्देशन भएको छ।’ भ्रमण १० दिनको हुने उनले बताए। महामन्त्री आचार्यको नेतृत्वमा हुने भ्रमणमा गणेश पराजुली, हरि ढकाल, कवीन्द्र बुर्लाकोटी, लिमा अधिकारी आचार्य, समीक्षा बास्कोटा, सागर ढकाल, सुशान्त वैदिक, रीमा विश्वकर्मा, रमेश कुमार सापकोटा, डा. धनञ्जय रेग्मी सहभागी हुनेछन्। यस्तै, गजला शमिम मिकरानी, श्रीराम न्यौपाने, डा. राम लामा, पुनम कुमारी अग्रवाल, डा. आनन्दबहादुर चन्द, डा. सुजाता तामाङ, पुष्पा कुमारी चौधरी, अरविन्द शाह र रत्ना थापा सहभागी हुनेछन्। Kathmandu. Prime Minister Balen Shah has met with the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) MPs who are about to visit China. Shah, who is also the leader of the RSS parliamentary party, called them at Singha Durbar today for discussions. At the formal invitation of the Communist Party of China (CPC), a high-level delegation of the party, led by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) General Secretary Bipin Acharya, is visiting China from Kartik 29. Chief Whip Kavindra Burlakoti said that the Prime Minister called them and gave them necessary instructions before the visit. He said, "We discussed some things about the visit, the relationship between the two countries, and some instructions from the Prime Minister on the precautions we should take while we were there." He said that the Prime Minister expressed confidence during the meeting that the visit of the party's lawmakers would be fruitful. He said, "The instructions were given to make the visit a success in deepening the relations between the two countries. There are many different benefits that our country can get from China, such as technology, trade, economic benefits and other dimensions, including tourism. Along with this, we can bring many things from China in terms of modernization of agriculture. Please pay more attention to this matter," he said. He also said that instructions have been issued not to limit visits to just sightseeing. Burlakoti added, "The visit has been directed to not just be a sightseeing trip, but to be a visit that can work for the interests of the two countries, especially for the interests of Nepal." He said the visit will last 10 days. The visit led by General Secretary Acharya will be attended by Ganesh Parajuli, Hari Dhakal, Kavindra Burlakoti, Lima Adhikari Acharya, Samiksha Baskota, Sagar Dhakal, Sushant Vaidik, Rima Bishwakarma, Ramesh Kumar Sapkota, and Dr. Dhananjay Regmi. Similarly, Ghazala Shamim Mikrani, Shriram Neupane, Dr. Ram Lama, Poonam Kumari Agrawal, Dr. Anand Bahadur Chand, Dr. Sujata Tamang, Pushpa Kumari Chaudhary, Arvind Shah and Ratna Thapa will participate.

Prime Minister Balen Shah has met with the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) MPs who are about to visit China. Shah, who is also the leader of the RSS parliamentary party, called them at Singha Durbar today for discussions. At the formal invitation of the Communist Party of China (CPC), a high-level delegation of the party, led by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) General Secretary Bipin Acharya, is visiting China from Kartik 29. Chief Whip Kavindra Burlakoti said that the Prime Minister called them and gave them necessary instructions before the visit. He said, "We discussed some things about the visit, the relationship between the two countries, and some instructions from the Prime Minister on the precautions we should take while we were there." He said that the Prime Minister expressed confidence during the meeting that the visit of the party's lawmakers would be fruitful. He said, "The instructions were given to make the visit a success in deepening the relations between the two countries. There are many different benefits that our country can get from China, such as technology, trade, economic benefits and other dimensions, including tourism. Along with this, we can bring many things from China in terms of modernization of agriculture. Please pay more attention to this matter," he said. He also said that instructions have been issued not to limit visits to just sightseeing. Burlakoti added, "The visit has been directed to not just be a sightseeing trip, but to be a visit that can work for the interests of the two countries, especially for the interests of Nepal." He said the visit will last 10 days. The visit led by General Secretary Acharya will be attended by Ganesh Parajuli, Hari Dhakal, Kavindra Burlakoti, Lima Adhikari Acharya, Samiksha Baskota, Sagar Dhakal, Sushant Vaidik, Rima Bishwakarma, Ramesh Kumar Sapkota, and Dr. Dhananjay Regmi. Similarly, Ghazala Shamim Mikrani, Shriram Neupane, Dr. Ram Lama, Poonam Kumari Agrawal, Dr. Anand Bahadur Chand, Dr. Sujata Tamang, Pushpa Kumari Chaudhary, Arvind Shah and Ratna Thapa will participate.

बुर्लाकोटीले थपे, ‘भ्रमणमा घुमघाम मात्रै नहोस्, दुई देशको हितको लागि र विशेषगरी नेपालको हितको लागि काम गर्नसक्ने हिसाबको भ्रमण होस् भन्ने हिसाबको निर्देशन भएको छ।’

भ्रमण १० दिनको हुने उनले बताए।

महामन्त्री आचार्यको नेतृत्वमा हुने भ्रमणमा गणेश पराजुली, हरि ढकाल, कवीन्द्र बुर्लाकोटी, लिमा अधिकारी आचार्य, समीक्षा बास्कोटा, सागर ढकाल, सुशान्त वैदिक, रीमा विश्वकर्मा, रमेश कुमार सापकोटा, डा. धनञ्जय रेग्मी सहभागी हुनेछन्।

यस्तै, गजला शमिम मिकरानी, श्रीराम न्यौपाने, डा. राम लामा, पुनम कुमारी अग्रवाल, डा. आनन्दबहादुर चन्द, डा. सुजाता तामाङ, पुष्पा कुमारी चौधरी, अरविन्द शाह र रत्ना थापा सहभागी हुनेछन्।

Kathmandu. Prime Minister Balen Shah has met with the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) MPs who are about to visit China. Shah, who is also the leader of the RSS parliamentary party, called them at Singha Durbar today for discussions. At the formal invitation of the Communist Party of China (CPC), a high-level delegation of the party, led by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) General Secretary Bipin Acharya, is visiting China from Kartik 29. Chief Whip Kavindra Burlakoti said that the Prime Minister called them and gave them necessary instructions before the visit. He said, "We discussed some things about the visit, the relationship between the two countries, and some instructions from the Prime Minister on the precautions we should take while we were there." He said that the Prime Minister expressed confidence during the meeting that the visit of the party's lawmakers would be fruitful. He said, "The instructions were given to make the visit a success in deepening the relations between the two countries. There are many different benefits that our country can get from China, such as technology, trade, economic benefits and other dimensions, including tourism. Along with this, we can bring many things from China in terms of modernization of agriculture. Please pay more attention to this matter," he said. He also said that instructions have been issued not to limit visits to just sightseeing. Burlakoti added, "The visit has been directed to not just be a sightseeing trip, but to be a visit that can work for the interests of the two countries, especially for the interests of Nepal." He said the visit will last 10 days. The visit led by General Secretary Acharya will be attended by Ganesh Parajuli, Hari Dhakal, Kavindra Burlakoti, Lima Adhikari Acharya, Samiksha Baskota, Sagar Dhakal, Sushant Vaidik, Rima Bishwakarma, Ramesh Kumar Sapkota, and Dr. Dhananjay Regmi. Similarly, Ghazala Shamim Mikrani, Shriram Neupane, Dr. Ram Lama, Poonam Kumari Agrawal, Dr. Anand Bahadur Chand, Dr. Sujata Tamang, Pushpa Kumari Chaudhary, Arvind Shah and Ratna Thapa will participate.
